title: 第13章 终于被嘲讽第14章 要素察觉婚约
content_zh:
接下来的一段时间，对于叶非凡来说又是非常充实的日子。
每天主要的任务就是修炼，有着微型聚灵阵和固灵佩的加持，他的修炼速度在同龄人中已经算得上是前列。
在修炼的同时，他也没有忘记‘轻盈术’的练习，还好这个术法本身属于辅助性质，所以慢慢的练习也行。
快乐而又和平的三个月过去了。
不出所料，叶非凡顺利的突破到了练气5重，在这期间，父亲叶虎和母亲孙素素也知道他在刻苦修炼，所以也没有催促他去叶家商铺跟着一起学习。
“哈哈哈，练气5重了，又升了一级，这种能够快速升级的感觉真是爽，难怪那些小说里面。”
突破练气5重后，叶非凡相当高兴，看了下大哥叶飞扬给的下品灵石，才用了一半，剩下的一半，兴许还能帮他突破到练气6重。
“咦，这微型聚灵阵的光芒是不是暗淡了些啊，好像大哥给我的时候就说过这个聚灵阵不是新的，是个二手货，啧啧，不会我还没到6重，就不行了吧。”
对于聚灵阵新的发现，又冲淡了一些修为突破后的喜悦感。
固灵佩和微型聚灵阵是他现阶段很重要的临时外挂，一但没有了这个临时外挂，他叶非凡又只能回到以前躺平开摆的状态了。
“话说飞扬大哥是真的厉害，前段时间居然都突破到练气12重了，这就尼玛离谱，人和人的差距怎么这么大呢，他当穿越者是不是更合适一些。”
在叶非凡努力修炼的这段时间内，叶飞扬通过家族检验大会上，叶家老祖赏赐的‘凝气丹’修炼，也一举突破到了练气十二重。
整个叶家听闻消息后上下鼓舞，直言叶飞扬就是辉月城年轻一辈第一人。
这个消息自然也传到了城主府和冯家那边，但两方都没有做出什么回应。
因此，在这段时间内，整个辉月城内，叶家的势头稍微的压过城主府和冯家一头。
“上次父亲说‘灵宝阁’那不定时会举办拍卖会，我的正式外挂会不会在那里面？不过我身上没钱，去了也没啥意义，就算发现了外挂，也买不到。愁人啊。”
叶非凡想到灵宝阁的拍卖会，就有点心烦，穷人的烦恼就是这么多。
“要不先去踩踩点，逛一逛，反正看看又不花钱，而且今天有没有拍卖会都不好说。“
思考了半天，叶非凡还是决定去踩踩点。
反正刚刚突破到练气5重，该出去放松放松了，这段时间的苦修是真的无聊。

……
出门后的叶非凡倒是没有直奔城南的灵宝阁。而是先跑去东城集市上转悠了一下。
毕竟之前身上时真的穷的叮当响，但是现在不同了，手上还有叶飞扬给的下品灵石，在出门的时候他拿了2块放到身上。
这下叶飞扬逛集市的心态就和之前有所不同了，有钱在身上，一点都不慌，虽然他知道这灵石肯定不会花出去的，毕竟还要用来修炼，但是有钱在手的话，心情也能快乐不少，很符合现在放松放松的想法。
转了一圈，果然还是毫无所获，但叶非凡也没有什么失望，这一切都在意料之中，基本上集市这个日常任务地点，他已经放弃了。
叶非凡逛完集市后驻足想了下，决定还是先不去找父母了，自己的修炼进度父母他们也都差不多了解，突破练气5重就是这几天的事，所以也不存在什么非要去给一个惊喜什么的。
随即，叶非凡直奔目标‘灵宝阁’。
走进灵宝阁后，发现王掌柜不在一楼。
“可能在二楼接待其他重要客人吧，那正好，我就在这里面逛逛，过过眼瘾。“心中一喜，赶紧一个柜台一个柜台的看过去。
还好灵宝阁中的柜台人员都是训练有素，没有对叶非凡这样的一看就是纯逛的人产生不满情绪，依然非常热心的回答他的问题。
“您好，请问这个长剑是什么法器？“
“这把长剑叫星越长剑，是一把极品法器，由黑岩铁经过七七四十九次捶打锻造而成，保证了其兼顾性，同时还添加了一些轻光石，使整个剑的重量维持在合适的范围内，还有这把剑对灵气的适应程度很高，使用剑系武技时，对攻击能有小幅度增幅，非常受到用剑修士们的喜爱。“
“星越长剑？这名字很响亮啊，会不会有危险？“
“那没有，这剑是得到星越皇朝认可的，并且作为制式武器，经常分配给皇朝中各个一线人员使用。“
看来是公务员标准佩剑，不过这个也有得卖？想来星越皇朝的锻造水平应该不低吧，毕竟都能做到批量制造了。
“那这件长袍呢？“
content_en:
The next period of time was another very fulfilling day for Ye Feifan.
The main task every day is to practice. With the blessing of the miniature spirit gathering array and the solid spirit pendant, his practice speed is already at the forefront among his peers.
While practicing, he did not forget to practice the 'Lightness Technique'. Fortunately, this technique itself was of an auxiliary nature, so it was okay to practice it slowly.
Three happy and peaceful months passed.
As expected, Ye Feifan successfully broke through to the fifth level of Qi training. During this period, his father Ye Hu and mother Sun Susu also knew that he was practicing hard, so they did not urge him to go to the Ye family store to study with him.
"Hahaha, I have reached the fifth level of Qi training and have been promoted to another level. This feeling of being able to upgrade quickly is really refreshing. No wonder it is in those novels."
After breaking through to the fifth level of Qi training, Ye Feifan was very happy. He looked at the low-grade spiritual stones given by his elder brother Ye Feiyang and only used half of them. The remaining half might help him break through to the sixth level of Qi training.
"Hey, isn't the light of this miniature spirit gathering array dimming a little? It seems that when my elder brother gave it to me, he said that this spirit gathering array is not new, but a second-hand product. Tsk, tsk, it won't work if I haven't reached the sixth level."
The new discovery of the Spirit Gathering Formation diluted some of the joy after the breakthrough in cultivation.
The Guling Pei and the Mini Spirit Gathering Array are very important temporary plug-ins for him at this stage. Without this temporary plug-in, Ye Feifan can only return to his previous state of lying flat and swinging open.
"Brother Feiyang is really powerful. He actually broke through to the 12th level of Qi training some time ago. This is outrageous. Why is there such a big gap between people? Isn't it more suitable for him to be a time traveler?"
During the period of Ye Feifan's hard training, Ye Feiyang passed the "Qi Condensing Pill" rewarded by the ancestor of the Ye family at the family inspection meeting, and also broke through to the twelfth level of Qi training in one fell swoop.
The entire Ye family was excited after hearing the news, saying that Ye Feiyang was the number one among the younger generation in Huiyue City.
This news naturally spread to the City Lord's Mansion and the Feng family, but neither party made any response.
Therefore, during this period of time, in the entire Huiyue City, the Ye family's momentum slightly surpassed that of the City Lord's Mansion and the Feng family.
"Last time, my father said that there will be auctions at Lingbao Pavilion from time to time. Will my official cheats be there? But I have no money, so there is no point in going there. Even if I find a cheat, I can't buy it. It's so worrying."
Ye Feifan was a little upset when he thought about the auction in Lingbao Pavilion. There were so many worries for the poor.
"Why don't you go to the popular spot first and take a look around? It doesn't cost any money anyway, and it's hard to say whether there will be an auction today."
After thinking for a long time, Ye Feifan decided to visit the spot.
Anyway, I have just broken through to the fifth level of Qi training, and it’s time to go out and relax. The hard training during this period is really boring.
…
After leaving the house, Ye Feifan did not go straight to Lingbao Pavilion in the south of the city. Instead, he went to Dongcheng Market for a while.
After all, he was really poor before, but it was different now. He still had the low-grade spiritual stones given by Ye Feiyang in his hand. When he went out, he took 2 pieces and put them on his body.
Now Ye Feiyang's mentality when going to the market is different from before. He has money on his body and is not worried at all. Although he knows that the spirit stone will definitely not be spent. After all, it will be used for cultivation. But if he has money in hand, he will feel much happier, which is in line with his current idea of ​​relaxing.
After walking around, he still found nothing, but Ye Feifan was not disappointed. All of this was expected. Basically, he had given up on the market as a daily mission location.
After Ye Feifan finished visiting the market, he stopped and thought for a moment, and decided not to go to his parents yet. His parents also knew about the progress of his cultivation. He had broken through to the fifth level of Qi training in the past few days, so there was no need to give him a surprise.Immediately, Ye Feifan went straight to the target ‘Lingbao Pavilion’.
After walking into Lingbao Pavilion, I found that shopkeeper Wang was not on the first floor.
"Maybe we will receive other important guests on the second floor. That's just right. I'll just stroll around here and enjoy my eyesight." I felt happy and hurriedly looked at the counters one by one.
Fortunately, the counter staff in Lingbao Pavilion were well-trained and did not feel dissatisfied with Ye Feifan, a person who looked like he was just shopping at first glance, and still answered his questions very enthusiastically.
"Hello, what kind of magic weapon is this long sword?"
"This long sword is called the Xingyue Long Sword. It is a top-quality magical weapon. It is forged from black rock iron after seven, seven and forty-nine times of hammering to ensure its balance. At the same time, some light stones are added to keep the weight of the entire sword within a suitable range. This sword is also very adaptable to spiritual energy. When using sword-based martial arts, the attack can be slightly increased. It is very popular among sword-wielding monks."
"Xingyue Changjian? The name is very loud. Is it dangerous?"
"No, this sword is approved by the Xingyue Dynasty, and as a standard weapon, it is often distributed to various front-line personnel in the dynasty."
It seems to be a standard sword for civil servants, but is this also for sale? I think the forging level of Xingyue Dynasty should be quite high, after all, they can produce in batches.
"What about this robe?"
